_comment: cargo-geiger baseline (T1174, tightened in #191): total unsafe items/expressions summed over workspace crates (used + unused). Audited per-crate floor: clj-aot=5 (jit.rs ExecutionEngine main lookup/call), clj-bc=0, clj-core=0, clj-eval=0 (env tests subprocess-isolated via Command::env/env_remove), clj-reader=0, clj-repl=0, clj-rt=154 (extern C ABI boundary shims/CSlice/Mixed/ActiveScope + rt_argv/argv_strings null guards), clj-value=3 (transient.rs TransientLock Acquire/Release spinlock: `unsafe impl Sync` + one audited cell dereference at lock time; std::sync::Mutex cannot replace it because the clj-bc bitcode helpers inline transient locking into AOT programs and std's out-of-line poison/contended paths do not link there), clojure-rs=162 (Cargo rollup folding dependencies: clj-aot 5 + clj-value 3 + clj-rt 154, own=0). Zero non-FFI/non-spinlock unsafe remains.
